causes: Non-uniform layer deposition (CVD/PVD)
Asymmetric pressure during chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP)
Thermal variations across the center of the heating platen
Center.check: Check the central gas nozzles in the process chamber and the planarity of the CMP head.

causes: Annular thermal profile or excessive radial gradient on the heating platen
Turbulent gas flow at the periphery of the central zone in the deposition reactor
Non-uniform abrasive slurry distribution in the CMP process
Donut.check: Inspect the concentric heating zones of the susceptor and the CMP slurry distribution system.

causes: Focus ring erosion in plasma etching
Deficient helium cooling on the edge of the electrostatic chuck (ESC)
Edge-Ring.check: Inspect the focus ring in the etching chamber and the edge helium pressure.

causes: Aggressive mechanical contact on the wafer edge during transfer
Localized thermal stress at the clamping pins
Edge-Loc.check: Check the aligner pins and the gripping force of the mechanical handling arm.

causes: Local defects on the photolithographic mask (reticle contamination)
Adherent particle during UV exposure or localized non-homogeneous deposition
Localized blockage of post-etch rinse nozzles
Loc.check: Inspect the photolithographic mask reticle and check the integrity of rinse nozzles in the process chamber.

causes: Widespread process failure (total vacuum loss or critical RF power drift)
Massive contamination of the chemical precursor supply line
Severe photolithographic calibration error across the entire wafer
Near-full.check: Immediately shut down the processing equipment, check the plasma RF generator and vacuum chamber integrity.

causes: Suspended particle contamination in the cleanroom
HEPA/ULPA filter failure above the workstation
Random.check: Measure particle concentration in the cleanroom enclosure and verify laminar airflow.

causes: Scratching caused by the robotic handling arm
Residual abrasive particles on vacuum suction cups
Scratch.check: Inspect the robotic arm trajectory and clean vacuum suction contact pads.

causes: Nominal operating parameters, no deviations detected
none.check: Authorize batch transfer to the next technological processing step.
